title: Online Yoga App — UX Case Study
summary: A mobile yoga app concept documented as a visual UX case study, exploring how an online wellness experience can be structured and presented clearly for mobile users.

seo.title: Online Yoga App UX Case Study | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: A mobile yoga app UX/UI case study by Shubham Pendse, presented through a structured visual case-study narrative created in Figma.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: This project explores the experience of an online yoga mobile app through a UX/UI case study. The work is presented as a concept project focused on organizing the mobile experience and communicating the design process through a structured visual narrative.
